description: The recipes the NPC Generator (module/blank-inheritance/scripts/core/npc-generator/statblock.mjs) builds a stat block from. An archetype names a BAND (extreme, high, moderate, low, terrible) for each statistic; the generator reads the number for that band at the NPC's level from tools/reference-extract/output/creature-building-math.json (GM Core, Building Creatures), so none of these recipes holds a number of its own. Pure SF2E: no campaign overlay. Non-combat archetypes have no strike and no abilities (D047 item 5); the people who might fight carry one plain strike. Skills are not in the archetype: they are chosen per person in data/campaign/npc-roster.json, where a role is told (a nurse's Medicine, a crane driver's Crafting). Drafted: Ingram corrects these, and the numbers follow.
source: GM Core, Building Creatures (pp. 118-124): attribute modifiers (996), Perception (997), skills (1000), Armor Class (1004), saving throws (1005), Hit Points (1006), strike attack bonus (1011), strike damage (1012); Building NPCs (1034).

noncombat-adult.label: An ordinary adult
noncombat-adult.description: Someone who is no threat in a fight however important or skilled they are: low armour and hit points, weak saves, a level that says so. Skills are chosen per person.

skilled-professional.label: A skilled professional
skilled-professional.description: A clerk, a quartermaster, a keeper, a nurse: sharp where their work is, no threat in a fight. Mind and manner are the good attributes.

scholar-teacher.label: A teacher or scholar
scholar-teacher.description: Someone whose strength is knowing things: the best attribute is Intelligence, Will is the good save, nothing is built for a fight.

tough-worker.label: A strong working adult
tough-worker.description: A welder, a crane driver, a foreman: used to heavy work, moderate armour and hit points, and able to hold their own in a scuffle with a plain unarmed strike. Not built to fight on purpose.

trainee.label: A candidate in training
trainee.description: A young person on the Directorate's pilot or ground track: moderate everything, no particular edge, a training baton rather than a weapon.

veteran-officer.label: A veteran officer
veteran-officer.description: Someone who has run things for a long time: moderate armour and hit points, a high Will, sharp eyes. Not a combatant; striking one ends in a hearing, not a fight.

brawler.label: A brawler
brawler.description: A thug, a soldier, a tug-hand: built to fight in melee. Moderate armour, high hit points and Fortitude, a high attack bonus and moderate damage (a club, not a blade).

performer.label: A performer
performer.description: A stage magician, a musician: quick and charming, frail, with a good Will. Illusions and patter, not a fight (no spellcasting is carried: a non-combat NPC has no features).

elder-power.label: A founder-grade power
elder-power.description: Someone vastly above a first-level party and still not beyond them (D047 item 5): high armour, hit points and every save, a high Perception, one extreme attribute is left to the roster to choose. Carries a plain strike for the day it matters.
